//: The leaves behind the ../api.ts facade have no module-scope effects of their own, but each imports the API client, so without this declaration Rolldown counts every leaf, and the facade, as side-effectful.

One eager import of the facade would then put every leaf on the critical path. A leaf nothing imports from is dropped whole; one whose exports are used keeps its module-scope statements, so a registerAuthReset call still runs whenever there is a cache to reset.
